qualification.note: Real-clock fixed offered rate is not maximum throughput, minimal-XRT baseline or mixed load. Millisecond wall precision and quantized owner samples limit fine tail decisions. Windows CPU increments are coarse and sometimes zero, not zero CPU cost. CPU is a non-gated observation; process creation/admission/shutdown CPU, a possible first-deadline crossing between the zero-dispatch check and separate CPU/heap snapshots, CRT/OS allocations and borrowed/native storage remain outside the corresponding windows/counters. All nine profiles retain original5 repeats/1 warmup/MAD3%/central6% and5%/10% regression settings. Raw outputs of54 actual processes per platform include warmups and every failed noise check; no favorable rerun/drop or forced comparison. WSL is not native Linux. Backend observations remain available per process and must match before any future qualified comparison.
